shared_tail.surface: عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن عمر

notes: «يعني ابن زريع» is an editor's gloss: left out
«- قال أبو كامل ابن الزبير -» names another transmitter at the slot after Ibn Ishaq's teacher: a variant remark, not a route
the chain ends at «أبيه», who is not named here; the Companion is not completed
